procedure: Create two exact-owned Plus Tr devices at published code PR #263 head with default built-in ID and same imported synthetic caller blocks. Keep wiimote bound, verify gen20/input/raw/LED identities, await owner grants and revalidate. Capture exact kernel evdev and libxwiimote concurrently for each attachment. Run SDL 3.2.10 MP-only and Nunchuk with an explicit kernel MP-event holder, exact-owned raw/input guard and separate cleanup. Run native Dolphin 2503 MP-only bound with an isolated emulated mapping profile and independent UI samples. Owner reads exact-device kernel log without changing debug settings; no inactive-ID hex is present. Close all consumers/devices idempotently and verify removal. No generic window, Cemu, Classic live or Plus generic passthrough.
semantic_outcome: SDL 3.2.10 Plus MP+Nunchuk opens the exact-owned HIDAPI joystick during a 60-second poll with no disconnect/removal. An explicit concurrent kernel MP-event holder sees changing gyro. SDL exposes/enables gyro but all polled angular arrays remain zero. No changing decoded SDL gyro is established; capability or successful value polling is not delivery. The underlying virtual gyro is not physically zero and no model fix follows. This is a bounded consumer observation with a holder precondition, not general SDL acceptance.
